title: I Will Love Them Freely
old_p1: Hosea’s people had kept wandering away from Heavenly Father. Wandering away is called backsliding. But Heavenly Father made a kind promise. “I will heal their backsliding,” He said. “I will love them freely.”
Freely means you do not have to earn it, and you never have to pay it back. It is a gift, given with a happy heart.
old_p2: “I will be as the dew unto Israel,” He said. Israel was His people. Dew is tiny water drops on the grass each morning. In that dry land, dew helped plants live.
“He shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots.” A lily is a pretty flower with deep roots. His people would grow beautiful and strong.
Heavenly Father loves you freely, just as you are. Tonight, feel His love settle over you like dew.
p1: The prophet Hosea’s people kept wandering away from Heavenly Father. Wandering away means not following Him anymore.
But Heavenly Father made a kind promise. He said, “I will heal their wandering away. I will love them freely.”
Freely means it is a gift. You do not have to earn it. You never have to pay it back.
p2: He said, “I will be like the dew to Israel.” Dew is tiny drops of water on morning grass. In that dry land, dew helped plants live. He said His people would grow like a lily, a pretty flower. Their roots would grow deep, like tall trees.
Heavenly Father loves you freely too, just as you are. Tonight you can whisper, “Thank You, Heavenly Father, for loving me.”
